claims.text: The FDA label associates aliskiren plus ACE inhibitors, the class containing benazepril, with more hypotension, hyperkalemia and renal impairment than monotherapy.
claims.quote: The concomitant use of aliskiren with other agents acting on the RAAS such as ACEIs or ARBs is associated with an increased risk of hypotension, hyperkalemia, and changes in renal function (including acute renal failure) compared to monotherapy.

claims.text: The FDA benazepril label prohibits coadministration with aliskiren in patients with diabetes.
claims.quote: Do not coadminister aliskiren with benazepril hydrochloride in patients with diabetes.

headline.text: The FDA label prohibits aliskiren with benazepril in diabetes and describes increased renal, potassium and blood-pressure risks from dual blockade.

reported.text: Aliskiren with an ACE inhibitor is associated with hypotension, hyperkalemia and changes in renal function, including acute renal failure.
